record.question: Which one is true about secured advance?
options: No TDS is to be deducted from the advance.
It can also be granted for perishable items if the contractor indemnifies the government under an insurance cover.
Recoveries of advances should be made only after completion of the whole work.
The engineer-in-charge sanctions the advance up to an amount exceeding 75 % of the materials.
record.explanation: Secured advance may be granted for perishable items with indemnity.
